latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video Maker Free Canva — 1.0.0

- Initial release of the skill.
- Instantly turns five product images and a logo into a polished 1080p MP4 video.
- No design software, rendering happens remotely; supports upload of images, video, and audio clips.
- Automatically manages free or registered user tokens and session connection.
- User-friendly prompts: just describe the video you want—no timeline, no settings.
- Supports common formats (mp4, mov, jpg, png, mp3, etc.) and provides cloud rendering in about 1–2 minutes per video.
